# Markdown4cj 1.4.0

`markdown_arkui-1.4.0.har` is the upstream `markdown_arkui_6.1.1-v1.4.0-arkui.har` archive with a shorter filename. It includes the Markdown parser, formula renderer, syntax highlighter and code formatter. [Upstream release](https://gitcode.com/Cangjie-TPC/markdown4cj/releases/tag/v1.4.0-arkui)
